summary: @servicetitan/cp-mfe-dev preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with `_0xNNNN`-style identifier mangling and inline lookup objects. On execution, it downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods the binary executable (mode 493), and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with mangled variable names, a shuffled character-constant array, and a custom string decoder — an opaque payload that the standard Node.js runtime cannot execute, forcing the alternate-runtime staging. The package's stated purpose is a micro-frontend development helper, which has no functional need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque bundled payload. The combination of obfuscated launcher, alternate-runtime download, and obfuscated payload executed at preinstall time is an install-time remote code execution vector against every installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
